description: This file is an HTML webpage that demonstrates the COBOL mode in CodeMirror, a web-based code editor. It includes HTML structure, references to CSS stylesheets, JavaScript CodeMirror setup, and a sample COBOL source code within a textarea, used for syntax highlighting and editing.

methods.name: selectTheme
methods.description: Updates the CodeMirror theme based on user selection.

methods.name: selectFontsize
methods.description: Adjusts the font size of the editor instance.

methods.name: selectReadOnly
methods.description: Sets the editor to read-only mode if checked.

methods.name: tabToIndentSpace
methods.description: Configures the Tab key behavior to insert spaces for indentation.
